The '''Outer Rim Regional Podracing Circuit''', known as '''Outer Rim Regionals''' was a series of three one-lap [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] courses on the following planets:

# [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] ([[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]])
# [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]
# [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] ([[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]])

The circuit was part of the [[Galactic Podracing Circuit/Legends|Galactic Podracing Circuit]], and was followed by the [[Professional Podracing Circuit]].
